_meta.source: Decree 243/2026/ND-CP (eff. 2026-06-26) amending Decree 57/2025/ND-CP (DPPA) and Decree 58/2025/ND-CP (rooftop solar); supersedes the 20% surplus cap
_meta.notes: Decree 243/2026 raises the rooftop solar surplus export cap from 20% (Decree 57/58 2025) to 50% as the general rule. Parties may agree to export beyond 50%, up to 100%, through 2030-12-31 where local grid capacity permits (transitional_over_cap_allowed_until / transitional_max_export_fraction below). Electricity discharged from BESS charged by rooftop solar is now explicitly tradable surplus (bess_discharge_tradable) -- not yet modeled in the settlement/finance layers of this repo. Surplus pricing formula is codified as the previous-year average electricity market price, capped at the maximum regional utility-scale ground-mount solar tariff without BESS (ex-VAT); no official prior-year average has been published as of this file's last_updated date, so surplus_purchase_rate_vnd_per_kwh/surplus_purchase_rate_usd_per_kwh are retained unchanged pending publication -- see docs/regulatory-watch.md. Sellers of surplus electricity require an electricity operation license unless exempt.

rooftop_solar.pricing_basis: Previous-year average electricity market price, capped at max regional utility-scale ground-mount solar tariff without BESS (ex-VAT), per Decree 243/2026
rooftop_solar.notes: Rooftop systems may sell up to 50% of total generation to grid as the general rule (Decree 243/2026, eff. 2026-06-26), with agreement to exceed 50% (up to 100%) permitted through 2030-12-31 where local grid capacity allows. Electricity discharged from BESS charged by rooftop solar is explicitly tradable surplus. Remainder must be self-consumed or curtailed. REopt mapping: can_net_meter=false, can_wholesale=true (limited), can_export_beyond_nem_limit=false.

dppa_ceiling_tariffs_vnd_per_kwh.notes: Maximum tariffs for private grid DPPAs set by MOIT. Excludes VAT. Parties negotiate within these ceilings. Tariffs vary by technology, storage inclusion, and region (North/Central/South).

dppa_ceiling_tariffs_usd_per_kwh.notes: Converted at VND 26,400/USD for convenience. Use VND values as authoritative.

bess_incentive_requirements.notes: BESS-equipped projects qualify for higher ceiling tariffs if: storage capacity >= 10% of plant capacity, storage duration >= 2 hours, and at least 5% of delivered power comes from stored output.

dppa_eligibility.notes: Grid-connected DPPAs require generators >= 10 MW and participation in VWEM. Private grid DPPAs have no minimum capacity but require dedicated transmission infrastructure.

reopt_mapping.notes: How Decree 57/58 2025 rules (as amended by Decree 243/2026) map to REopt input parameters.
